acceptance_commands: uv sync --frozen && for i in 1 2 3; do uv run pytest -q tests/test_x1_line_message_baseurl.py || exit 9; done
for i in 1 2 3; do env -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy make verify || exit 8; done

env -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy bash -c 'O=$(uv run pytest -q -s tests/test_x1_line_message_baseurl.py -k end_to_end 2>&1); rc=$?; line=$(printf "%s\n" "$O" | grep -cE "^e2e delivered=1 code=- message_id=\S+ http_hits=[1-9][0-9]* prod_touch=0$"); echo "e2e_rc=$rc e2e_lines=$line"; test "$rc" -eq 0 -a "$line" -ge 1'
